legend: There is one apple tree in Arkady's garden. It can be represented as a set of junctions connected with branches so that there is only one way to reach any junctions from any other one using branches. The junctions are enumerated from 1%%ZSMJ0%% to n%%ZSMJ1%%, the junction 1%%ZSMJ2%% is called the root.

A subtree of a junction v%%ZSMJ3%% is a set of junctions u%%ZSMJ4%% such that the path from u%%ZSMJ5%% to the root must pass through v%%ZSMJ6%%. Note that v%%ZSMJ7%% itself is included in a subtree of v%%ZSMJ8%%.
A leaf is such a junction that its subtree contains exactly one junction.

The New Year is coming, so Arkady wants to decorate the tree. He will put a light bulb of some color on each leaf junction and then count the number happy junctions. A happy junction is such a junction t%%ZSMJ9%% that all light bulbs in the subtree of t%%ZSMJ10%% have different colors.

Arkady is interested in the following question: for each k%%ZSMJ11%% from 1%%ZSMJ12%% to n%%ZSMJ13%%, what is the minimum number of different colors needed to make the number of happy junctions be greater than or equal to k%%ZSMJ14%%?
input: The first line contains a single integer n%%ZSMJ15%% (1≤n≤105%%ZSMJ16%%) — the number of junctions in the tree.

The second line contains n−1%%ZSMJ17%% integers p2%%ZSMJ18%%, p3%%ZSMJ19%%, ..., pn%%ZSMJ20%% (1≤pi<i%%ZSMJ21%%), where pi%%ZSMJ22%% means there is a branch between junctions i%%ZSMJ23%% and pi%%ZSMJ24%%. It is guaranteed that this set of branches forms a tree.
output: Output n%%ZSMJ25%% integers. The i%%ZSMJ26%%-th of them should be the minimum number of colors needed to make the number of happy junctions be at least i%%ZSMJ27%%.
note: In the first example for k=1%%ZSMJ28%% and k=2%%ZSMJ29%% we can use only one color: the junctions 2%%ZSMJ30%% and 3%%ZSMJ31%% will be happy. For k=3%%ZSMJ32%% you have to put the bulbs of different colors to make all the junctions happy.

In the second example for k=4%%ZSMJ33%% you can, for example, put the bulbs of color 1%%ZSMJ34%% in junctions 2%%ZSMJ35%% and 4%%ZSMJ36%%, and a bulb of color 2%%ZSMJ37%% into junction 5%%ZSMJ38%%. The happy junctions are the ones with indices 2%%ZSMJ39%%, 3%%ZSMJ40%%, 4%%ZSMJ41%% and 5%%ZSMJ42%% then.
